name: Fake profile of a contact requesting money
description: A message from an unrecognised account claims to be a known contact ('I made a new account') and asks for money urgently.

source_references.quote: Fraudsters use Fake Profile of the victim

explanation.plain: An account claiming to be someone you know is asking for money. Impersonating a contact with a new account is a common scam. Verify on a number you already have.
explanation.technical: FAKE_PROFILE_CLAIM (identity) with a payment demand/urgency/secrecy. CERT-In: fraudsters use fake profiles of the victim's contacts.
verification_steps: Call the person on a number you already have saved.
Do not send money based on a new or unrecognised account.
